items.title: Fred Wesley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 21, 2024
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I remember referring to — reading about Coleman Hawkins that way... [INTERVIEWEE] Right. Vertical, horizontal.

ctx.x: Well on one chord you have to vary what you play, you have to make it sound like it’s a lot of chords you know. I guess you would play different things the same way you know. I can’t explain it exactly but with one chord you would do, you could up and down, the music goes up and down rather than sideways. You know? But for bebop you’ve got total freedom to follow the changes, right? But when you only have one change then you have to play it up and down. Do you understand? Up and down is better than sideways. It’s…
I remember referring to — reading about Coleman Hawkins that way, that they were talking about he played vertical instead of horizontal.
